input._script:
using Base64, JSON3, Random
const PAYLOAD_B64 = ""
root = mktempdir(get(ENV, "WORK", "/tmp"))
write(joinpath(root, "p.tgz"), base64decode(PAYLOAD_B64))
run(`tar -xzf $(joinpath(root, "p.tgz")) -C $root`)
include(joinpath(root, "STADE.jl", "src", "STADE.jl"))
using CUDA
import JACC
JACC.@init_backend
import Atomix
CUDA.allowscalar(false)
# primal arguments per kernel: (name => builder(n, rng, kind))
function pargs(name, n, rng, kind)
    m = 6
    pos = kind == "mixed" ? [rand(rng) < 0.8 ? 1e-9 : 4.0 * rand(rng) + 0.5 for _ in 1:n] : kind == "spread" ? exp.(rand(rng, n) .* 8 .- 1) : rand(rng, n) .+ 0.5
    if name == "f6_solver";        return Any[pos, zeros(n), 1e-6, n]
    elseif name == "f6_nested_while"; return Any[min.(pos, 6.0), zeros(n), 1e-2, n]
    elseif name == "f6_while_zero"; return Any[pos .* 60 .+ 40, zeros(n), n]
    elseif name == "f6_early_exit"; return Any[rand(rng, n, m) .+ 0.1, [kind == "mixed" ? 0.2 : 2.0], zeros(n), n, m]
    elseif name == "f6_for_in_while"; return Any[rand(rng, n, m) .+ 0.1, zeros(n), kind == "mixed" ? 0.5 : 1e-3, n, m]
    end
end
function seeds(pargs_, tanargs, pnames)
    out = Any[]
    for (an) in tanargs
        s = String(an)
        if an in pnames
            push!(out, pargs_[findfirst(==(an), pnames)])
        else
            base = Symbol(s[1:end-1]); i = findfirst(==(base), pnames)
            v = pargs_[i]
            push!(out, v isa AbstractArray ? 0.3 .* ones(size(v)) .+ 0.1 .* rand(size(v)...) : 0.7)
        end
    end
    out
end
out = Any[]
for name in ["f6_solver","f6_early_exit","f6_nested_while","f6_for_in_while","f6_while_zero"]
    primal = STADE.io_read_corpus_entry(joinpath(root, "k", name * ".jl"))
    k = STADE.parse_kernel(primal)
    pnames = collect(k.sig.args)
    for mode in ("primal", "tangent")
        expr = mode == "primal" ? primal : STADE.stade_tangent(primal; keep_push_pop = false, fuse_ii_loops = true)
        fname = expr.args[1].args[1]
        Core.eval(Main, expr)
        plans = Dict("cuda" => STADE.stade_gpu(expr, STADE.cgen_backend_cuda()), "jacc" => STADE.stade_jacc(expr))
        fns = Dict{String,Any}(); nk = Dict{String,Int}()
        for (be, pl) in plans
            for kk in pl.kernels; Core.eval(Main, kk); end
            hasproperty(pl, :helpers) && for h in pl.helpers; Core.eval(Main, h); end
            Core.eval(Main, pl.host)
            fns[be] = getfield(Main, Symbol(fname, "_", be)); nk[be] = length(pl.kernels)
        end
        tanargs = collect(expr.args[1].args[2:end])
        for kind in ("uniform", "spread", "mixed"), n in (1000, 50000)
            rng = MersenneTwister(5)
            pa = pargs(name, n, rng, kind)
            args = mode == "primal" ? pa : seeds(pa, tanargs, pnames)
            ref = deepcopy(args)
            Base.invokelatest(getfield(Main, fname), ref...)
            for be in ("cuda", "jacc")
                try
                    dev = [a isa AbstractArray ? (be == "cuda" ? CUDA.CuArray(copy(a)) : JACC.array(copy(a))) : a for a in args]
                    Base.invokelatest(fns[be], dev...); CUDA.synchronize()
                    err = 0.0; changed = 0
                    for (d, r, a) in zip(dev, ref, args)
                        d isa AbstractArray || continue
                        h = Array(d)
                        err = max(err, maximum(abs.(h .- r) ./ max.(abs.(r), 1e-300)))
                        changed += count(h .!= a)
                    end
                    push!(out, Dict("kernel" => name, "mode" => mode, "backend" => be, "kind" => kind, "n" => n, "kernels" => nk[be], "changed" => changed,
                                    "status" => (err < 1e-9 && changed > 0) ? "ok" : "MISMATCH", "max_rel_err" => err))
                catch e
                    push!(out, Dict("kernel" => name, "mode" => mode, "backend" => be, "kind" => kind, "n" => n, "status" => "exception", "msg" => first(sprint(showerror, e), 300)))
                end
            end
        end
    end
end
println(JSON3.write(Dict("results" => out)))
